# GTM Marketer & Engineer

Build and scale GenHealth's go-to-market infrastructure through systematic experimentation, outbound automation, and data-driven campaign execution.

## ABOUT THE GTM ENGINEER AT GENHEALTH

GenHealth.ai is transforming the healthcare industry with cutting-edge Generative AI technology. We're seeking a technical and analytically-minded Founding GTM Engineer to build the systems and infrastructure behind our go-to-market motion.

Reporting to the Head of Sales & Operations, you'll own the architecture and execution of our outbound engine, ad campaigns, and landing page experimentation. While this role requires genuine engineering ability, it's built for someone who also has the taste to craft compelling messaging and understand what resonates with a buyer. You'll run structured experiments, measure what works, and scale it — turning GTM into a repeatable, data-driven system.

## Responsibilities

- Outbound Infrastructure: Build and maintain outbound email systems, sequences, and automation tooling that can run at scale
- Experimentation: Design and run structured A/B and multivariate tests across outbound messaging, email sequences, ad copy, and landing pages — with clean measurement frameworks
- Ad Campaigns: Set up, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, and other relevant channels
- Landing Page Optimization: Build and iterate on landing pages, running experiments to improve conversion rates and understand what messaging works inbound
- Messaging Development: Work with leadership to test and refine positioning and copy across channels — writing and editing enough content to fuel experiments
- Analytics & Reporting: Instrument campaigns and systems to track performance end-to-end, surface insights, and inform what to scale or kill
- Tooling & Integrations: Evaluate, implement, and maintain the GTM tech stack — CRM integrations, enrichment tools, sequencing platforms, ad platforms, and more
- Automation: Build lightweight automations and workflows to reduce manual work and increase throughput across the GTM team
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales and leadership to ensure outbound efforts align with pipeline goals and feedback from the field

## Requirements

- 3–5 years of experience in a technical marketing, growth engineering, or GTM engineering role
- Genuine software engineering ability — comfortable writing scripts, building integrations, and working with APIs
- Strong understanding of outbound email infrastructure (deliverability, sequencing, domain health)
- Experience designing and measuring experiments with statistical rigor
- Hands-on experience with paid advertising platforms (Lin

About the role

# GTM Operations Generalist (Sales + Customer + Revenue Ops)

Own the systems and workflows that keep our commercial engine running smoothly.

## ABOUT THE GTM OPS GENERALIST ROLE AT GENHEALTH

Own the systems and workflows that keep our commercial engine running smoothly. GenHealth.ai is hiring a GTM Operations Generalist to be a high-agency “glue” operator across sales, customer success, and revenue operations.

Reporting to the Head of Sales & Operations, you’ll help build and run the operating system behind our growth—covering invoicing and collections tracking, contract workflows, CRM hygiene, reporting, and customer onboarding coordination. This is a strong fit for someone with consulting, client services, or biz ops experience who wants real ownership and execution.

## Responsibilities

Commercial Operations

- Build and maintain lightweight systems that keep deals moving, customers onboarded, and revenue collected
- Manage invoicing workflow and AR tracking; coordinate collections follow-up as needed
- Own deal desk and contract workflows (proposals, MSAs, approvals, version control)

CRM, Reporting & Enablement

- Keep Attio data clean and reliable across pipeline, contacts, and activities
- Produce weekly reporting on pipeline health, revenue, and operational KPIs
- Support forecasting and GTM operating cadence with clean data and follow-through

Sales-to-CS Transition

- Build handoff processes and tools between sales and customer success using AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
- Design and implement automated workflows to streamline customer onboarding and success touchpoints
- Temporarily manage high-value customer relationships during transitions to ensure continuity and exceptional experience

What success looks like (first 90 days)

- Invoicing, Stripe, and AR tracking are consistent and trustworthy
- CRM data is clean enough to support forecasting and leadership decisions
- Contracts, onboarding, and GTM workflows run with less friction
- Easy transitions from won sales to customer success

## Requirements

- 3–5 years of experience in consulting, client services, biz ops, sales ops, or rev ops
- Startup experience strongly preferred—comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments
- Expert-level proficiency with Google Drive organization and Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides)
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills—nothing falls through the cracks
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
- Comfortable learning new tools quickly and adapting to changing priorities
- Experience with or willingness to learn: Attio (CRM), Stripe (payments), Mailchimp (email marketing), Dripify (LinkedIn automation), No

Senior BDR - Medical Groups/Providers — Careers at GenHealth.ai

# Senior BDR - Medical Groups/Providers

Help drive growth in the provider and medical group market through outbound sales, conferences, and relationship-building. Hustle, travel, and close deals at a fast-moving healthtech startup.

# Senior BDR

ABOUT THE SENIOR BDR - MEDICAL GROUPS/PROVIDERS ROLE AT GENHEALTH

GenHealth.ai is transforming the way healthcare works, and we are looking for an exceptional Senior BDR with experience selling into healthcare organizations to join our team. As a member of our team, you will be at the forefront of generative AI in healthcare, making a significant impact on the lives of patients around the world.

## Responsibilities

Prospect and qualify new leads via cold calls, email campaigns, and networking

Attend conferences and visit medical group/provider facilities to build relationships in person

Create and manage a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities

Support demos, pitches, and proposals to move deals forward

Collaborate with the founding team on sales strategy, messaging, and feedback loops

Hit ambitious goals and help us grow rapidly over the next 6-12 months

## Requirements

1–3 years of sales or business development experience (preferably in healthcare)

Hustle and hunger—you’re willing to grind and excited to win

Strong verbal and written communication skills

High attention to detail and organizational chops

Comfortable working remotely and independently

A self-starter with a team-first mindset

Willingness to travel (10-15% Conferences, 10-20% Local Prospecting)

## Compensation & Benefits

The salary for this role is $60,000 – $80,000 plus commission with OTE resulting in total compensation of $100,000 - $120,000. In addition to cash compensation the following are also included:

- Healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for your entire family
- Equity (stock options) valued between $10,000 - $50,000.
- Unlimited vacation and 15+ company holidays per year
- Work directly with the founders

At GenHealth.ai, we are transforming the healthcare industry with cutting-edge Generative AI technology. As a Senior BDR at our company, you will work on projects that will improve the lives of millions of patients around the world. If you are passionate about using AI to make a significant impact on the healthcare industry and have experience in scaling Transformer Neural Network in production, we encourage you to apply today!

We take pride in our focus on equity. We are a proud equal opportunity employer and encourage individuals from all backgrounds and identities to apply for this position. We believe in fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and are committed to supporting our employees’ professional growth and development.

### Apply for Senior BDR - Medical Groups/Providers

Send us your resume and a short note on why you're excited about this role.

_request.query:
Company: GenHealth.ai (website https://genhealth.ai).
Test to verify: Actively hiring now, with at least one open go-to-market role.
How it is tested: At least one requisition listed today on the company's own careers page or ATS board with a GTM title: sales, marketing, growth, ABM, demand generation, SDR or BDR, partnerships, revenue operations.
Decide pass, fail or unclear for THIS company today, citing the freshest relevant source.
_request.systemPrompt: Today is 2026-09-10. You are verifying one qualification test for one specific company. Use only what the sources say. The most recent dated announcement of an event is the authority on the company's current state; older announcements are history; company profile pages (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, CB Insights, Tracxn) are secondary to the company's own pages and to dated news. Never confuse the company with a same-name company on a different website. Answer pass only when a source states the fact; fail only when a source contradicts the test; otherwise unclear. The evidence_quote must be copied verbatim from the cited source.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences: what the freshest relevant source says and how it decides the test.

evidence_quote.description: A verbatim sentence or fragment from the cited source that decides the verdict; empty if unclear.

evidence_url.description: The URL the quote comes from; empty if unclear.

evidence_date.description: The date of that source as shown on it (YYYY-MM-DD if known); empty if unknown.
